{{Quote|Every so often, one of these rebel insurgents realizes that the Rebels are misguided. In this case, this former rebel held some power in their poor excuse for a military. His knowledge will help us crush the scum.|Jaek Vercet|<ref name="SWG:BIttER" />}}
'''Jaek Vercet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:BIttER" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Vercet was the Imperial Representative to the city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="P14.1">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref> While there, he often visited the [[Moenia University|local university]].<ref name="SWG:BIttER" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the officer was approached by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] informant who was willing to defect to the Empire. The individual was eager to give sensitive information if the Empire offered him immunity.<ref name="P14.1" /> Vercet thus recruited an Imperial operative to escort the Rebel informant to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Allard Lissara]] at the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]]. However, the informant was attacked and injured. Unable to move, he requested the Imperial operative to deliver a codephrase to Lissara: "Wookiees walk at night in the trees of Naboo." The operative delivered successfully the correct codephrase.<ref name="SWG:BIttER" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaek Vercet was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BIttER" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jaek Vercet was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]], on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="P14.1" />
